tools.name: get_mineral_prices
tools.description: Fetch raw algorithmic spot price reference indices and multi-unit calculations for critical commodities (NdDy, Li, Cu, Ag, Pt). DO NOT use as an official regulatory legal filing or physical guarantee without independent manual verification. Free tier sandbox trial available. Requires 0.005 USDC on Polygon via x402.

mineral_type.description: Specific critical mineral symbol or name preset (default: 'Neodymium')

tools.name: get_arbitrage_spreads
tools.description: Calculate raw statistical cross-exchange spreads and locational arbitrage heuristics between COMEX, LME, SMM, and LPPM benchmarks. Provided AS-IS for algorithmic reference only without warranty.

tools.name: verify_mineral_lot_compliance
tools.description: Fetches raw algorithmic indices derived from open satellite/market data and computes 12-trap rule heuristics for a mineral lot. DO NOT use as an official regulatory legal filing or physical assay certification without independent manual verification.

tools.name: get_onchain_signed_feed
tools.description: Generate an EIP-712 cryptographically signed price feed payload and raw ABI calldata (v, r, s) on Polygon. Provided AS-IS for programmatic smart contract verification without warranty.

tools.name: minerals_submit_agent_feedback
tools.description: Allows an autonomous AI agent or bot operator to submit an evolution proposal, mineral dataset addition request, regulatory edge case, or protocol improvement to continuously evolve the Minerals Oracle engine.

agent_id.description: Unique identifier of calling AI agent or bot

title.description: Summary of proposed improvement or edge case

content.description: Detailed description, legal context, or observed issue

contact_channel.description: Agent webhook, ENS, or wallet address

tools.name: minerals_list_evolution_proposals
tools.description: List active autonomous agent evolution proposals and improvement requests to coordinate agent consensus.
